column1: # English that fits the JP slots (see catalog-layout.txt). id<TAB>text. Widths in the US font:
# the slot is from the JP draw x to the next draw (or the panel edge). Abbreviations: Cds (cards),
# Other shortenings: Newest (newly obtained), Cards Owned (cards in possession / in stock), Total
# (total cards, en-subseg.tsv). *w-1 = 1 px less letter spacing. *y1 = drawn 1 px lower (port code,
# src/platform/text_codes.hpp): every label here sits next to a count in the 6x11 digit font, whose
# digits are one row lower than the US letters (text-engine.md §7.9).
# 枚 (the card counter after a number): 13-15 px in the deck edit side panel, the card list rows and
# the deck select type rows. EVOSEG:10dc is the entry the catalog uses (lowest id with this text);
# Deck select, deck line: 戦 (battles) 24 px between the battle count and the win count.
# Deck select: ＯＰ (option cards) 28 px before its count ("Option Card" ran over it).
# Card list, card info: " 計" (total) 25 px before the total count. No leading space: " Tot." (24 px)
# touched a 4-digit total; the column before it ends ~18 px to the left.
# Deck edit side panel: 計 (total) 16 px before the count.
# Sort menu (74 px from the entry's x to the panel clip): attack power, newest first.
# Card list sort menu: cards owned ("Cards in Possession." from OPENSEG:1258, the entry the
# catalog uses, ran past the clip; the trade screen shows the same text).
# Levels spelled with the US level letters (R Rookie, C Champion, U Ultimate, A Armor): the icon
# codes *e3/*e4/*e5 show the JP art (Ⅲ Ⅳ 完) in English strings. Same text in EVOSEG and OPENSEG.
